title: Signed-in CLI needs PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID set by hand on a tenant site
description: papyrus editorial context on Machines on Machines fails with: Editorial record tenant does not match the configured authoring scope. It works only with PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID=machines-on-machines, and nothing tells the user that value. papyrus login <site> should be enough. The site's public login file does not publish the tenant. Same theme as PPY-83e413, which needs PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT set by hand.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Tested 2026-11-03 with CLI 5.83.0: no PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID needed for stories show or assignments context-pack on Machines on Machines. Looks fixed for those commands; issue is still open on the board.
